name: delta-histogram
title: Delta histogram
description: Histogram of differences on a shared measure for matched records, with a tolerance band and side counts.
needs: A numeric measure and records on both sides.

text.title: {left} against {right}
text.lede: Distribution of {measure} differences ({rightShort} minus {leftShort}). Records within tolerance fall inside the shaded band.
text.chartSub: Tolerance is {tolerance} per {unitOne}. Bar heights are compressed with a square-root scale. Select a bar.
text.unmatchedSub: These have no difference to plot.

options.name: binWidth
options.description: Width of each histogram bin in measure units; defaults to the tolerance or an auto-calculated step.

options.name: maxBins
options.description: Maximum number of bins to display on each side of zero before grouping into beyond bins.
